policy: Only fetch and redistribute data after confirming the source or record licence. This manifest describes approved acquisition paths; it is not proof that data are already downloaded.

sources.name: Crystallography Open Database
sources.allowed_action: Download selected structure IDs as CIF; retain original author acknowledgement and COD identifiers.
sources.bulk_policy: Keep full snapshots out of Git; use pinned archival storage.

sources.name: RCSB Protein Data Bank archive
sources.allowed_action: Download selected PDB/mmCIF entries; check integrated external resource annotations individually.
sources.bulk_policy: Do not bundle the archive; cache curated entries and preserve PDB IDs and authors.

sources.name: Open Reaction Database
sources.licence: CC-BY-SA-4.0; raw data not approved for automatic student-facing publication
sources.allowed_action: Use the schema and record metadata as a research reference. Any later record subset must be independently teacher-screened for age-appropriate educational use and preserve attribution/share-alike.
sources.bulk_policy: No raw procedure bulk import into the student product. Curate a safe educational subset only after educator review, provenance verification and explicit publication approval.

sources.name: PubChem
sources.licence: Mixed contributor provenance; review source-level terms
sources.allowed_action: Use only educator-approved classroom structure records; preserve CID and per-record/source provenance.
sources.bulk_policy: No unrestricted lookup or bulk mirror in the student product. Add further structures only after educator review, rate-limit requests, and verify contributor terms before redistribution.

sources.name: NIST Chemistry WebBook SRD 69
sources.allowed_action: Link/cite record pages and query only as permitted by the service terms.
sources.bulk_policy: Do not mirror or redistribute the corpus until permissions are confirmed.

sources.name: CIAAW
sources.licence: Official reference; confirm reuse before republishing tables
sources.allowed_action: Link/cite 2024 or later official standard atomic-weight data; transcribe only after terms check.
sources.bulk_policy: Do not assume every table may be redistributed without conditions.

sources.name: IUPAC Gold Book
sources.licence: Verify current term and compilation reuse terms
sources.allowed_action: Link to canonical terms; write original explanations with citations.
sources.bulk_policy: Do not mirror complete content without confirming current rights.

sources.name: RDKit
sources.allowed_action: Use as a software dependency with required notices; evaluate browser/WASM support.
sources.bulk_policy: Not a dataset; pin code version and dependencies.

sources.name: PhET Chemistry simulations
sources.licence: Check CC BY-NC 4.0 and individual asset terms
sources.allowed_action: Benchmark teaching approaches; build original simulations unless reuse permission is confirmed.
sources.bulk_policy: Do not bundle competitor simulation code/assets as a shortcut.
